description_en: Migrates an SQL Server database to the cloud by using physical migration
kebab_example: aliyun dts switch-physical-dts-job-to-cloud --dts-job-id 'l5512es7w15****' --dts-instance-id 'dtsl3m1213ye7l****' --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --region cn-hangzhou
name: SwitchPhysicalDtsJobToCloud

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration or synchronization instance. You can call the describedtsjobs operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移或同步实例id，可以通过调用describedtsjobs接口查询
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the migration, synchronization, or change tracking instance
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: Forward.
Reverse: Reverse.

Default value: Forward.
You can specify Reverse to release the reverse synchronization link only when the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
当数据同步实例的拓扑为双向时，才可以传入Reverse以释放反向同步链路
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see the list of supported regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

DynamicCode.description_en: The dynamic error code. This parameter will be deprecated
DynamicCode.description_zh: 动态错误码，本参数即将下线

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace the %s placeholder in the ErrMessage error message.
If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the specified request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when an error occurs
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when an error occurs
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
